crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Diffuse, elliptical orange-brown wash extending from the posterior crown onto the nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct and non-linear transition with very low color contrast between the crown and upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright orange-red conical beak; prominent circular orange auricular patch; sharp black and white horizontal transverse barring across the tail and rump.
